recommendation.description: Your core recommendation in 1-3 decisive sentences.

why.description: 3-5 terse supporting points. Trade-offs, not slogans.

sketch.description: Concrete artifact: DDL, a formula, a UI state table, a procurement spec, or a worked example. Exempt from the word budget. Empty string if genuinely not applicable.

can_a_numeric_score_exist.description: Your verdict on whether a defensible numeric score is derivable from the 13 verified records.

what_it_would_mean.description: If yes or yes_with_severe_limits: the score's explicit contract — what it claims and what it must never be read as. If no: empty string.

what_replaces_it_if_not.description: If no or yes_with_severe_limits: the honest representation that replaces or supplements it.

brief_corrections.description: Errors you found in the moderator's brief after reading the actual files. Empty array if none — but check before claiming none.

procurement_implications.description: What your recommendation demands of unselected hardware. Empty array if none.

assumptions.description: What you take for granted that could be false.

risks.description: How YOUR OWN recommendation could fail.

cheap_validation.description: One check runnable in under an hour.

change_mind_if.description: The specific finding that would flip you.
